posts.text: You can’t “reverse aging.” That defies the laws of nature, not to mention common sense. Time marches on. You get older. No way to stop it. I really don’t understand this overwhelming fear of aging that people have. I turned 40 this year and it meant almost nothing to me. I’m not embarrassed by it or afraid of it or freaked out or anything. It is what it is. I’m getting older. Eventually I’ll be dead. No sense wasting time panicking over it or trying to avoid what can’t be avoided.
